note: Shelby County Conservation area in hardwood timber on Elk Horn Creek, 2 mi southwest of Elk Horn (532 Yellowwood Rd). The electric sites have grass pads; no pad lengths are posted, so whether a 23-ft motorhome fits is unconfirmed. --Claude
summary: Rate $20 electric confirmed (2026 county pages); $18 is the non-electric/tent rate, so the base moves 18 -> 20. Added 30-amp, FCFS only, season Apr 15-Oct 15, flush + pit toilets. Site count left at 11 (pages conflict: 7 electric now vs 11/8 on the older page). Stays not waterfront.
flags: FEES BASE 18 -> 20: the $18 rate is for 'non-electric/tent sites' alongside 'several tent camping sites', so it is not shown to be a site a 23-ft motorhome fits; the $20 electric rate is the base. If the non-electric sites take RVs, $18 would be the low.

SITE COUNT conflict: the park page lists '7 electrical sites with 30amp ... grass pads' plus 'several tent camping sites'; the older Camping activity page says '11 campsites, 8 with electrical hookups' (with a stale '$10 per night'). Stored count 11 (note prose) left unchanged.
PHONE MISSING: Shelby County Conservation (712) 744-3403 (mycountyparks.com/County/Shelby and shelbycounty.iowa.gov/conservation/).
WEBSITE: county conservation page is https://shelbycounty.iowa.gov/conservation/ (the old shco.org link redirects to the county home page).

WATERFRONT (confirms not waterfront): Elk Horn Creek runs along the park's north edge and is about 6-8 m wide on imagery (creek-sized); the pin is about 150-200 m south of it in unbroken hardwood canopy, with a small farm pond (well under 5 acres) between. No pads are visible under canopy, so no site can be shown on the bank. Overpass was down (imagery estimates).
FIT UNCLEAR, keep with caveat: grass pads, no lengths posted; gravel park drives wind through the timber on imagery. Caveat added to the proposed note.
PIN: 41.56923,-95.08978 is in the timber between the park drives; the sites cannot be seen under canopy, so the pin cannot be checked closer than that.
